changes.to: 10-inch tablet head unit (Qualcomm MSM8953, 8 cores, 3 GB RAM, 32 GB storage)

Specs are from ZoraBots' own James manual (revision 2019-11-12, support@zorabots.com), hosted on the ZBOS documentation portal: 420 x 420 x 800 mm (L x W x H), 17 kg INCLUDING packaging, omnidirectional tripod wheel configuration (three wheels), 14.4 V 13 Ah Li-ion 18650 pack (187.2 Wh as the manual states it), 10-inch tablet head unit (Qualcomm MSM8953, 8 cores, 2.0 GHz, 3 GB RAM, 32 GB storage, 13 MP camera), 6-microphone ring array and two 5 W speakers, 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 4.0, LiDAR SLAM with a 0.15-8 m range. Operating time is given as 9-12 h (range, not a single figure) and is left empty. zorabots.com returned HTTP 500 when checked on 2026-11-28, so the manual copy on the ZBOS documentation portal is the source used.
ZoraBots' wheeled guidance robot (hardware built by Siasun) that runs the ZBOS operating system to greet visitors, talk through its tablet and lead them to a point of interest.
